hard_case: a strict custom matcher under `.not` rules out one value only, so any result other than 151 passes

truth.toolchain: node 22.22.0; jest 30.5.2, ts-jest 29.4.14, typescript 5.9.3; edit applied by hand and the test command run on the whole package

mutants.equivalence_review: not equivalent: changes the value the changed line returns

reasoning: `amount > 0` becomes `amount > 5`, so `feeCents(1.5)` returns 0 instead of 150. The assertion is `.not.toBeCents(151)`, which 0 satisfies. RIPR-SPEC-0262 example 4: a negated custom matcher records no `toBeCents` assertion.
